top_signals.title: Kimberly-Clark Raises $4.9 Billion for Tylenol Maker Takeover
top_signals.summary: Kimberly-Clark Corp. raised $4.9 billion Monday from an investment-grade bond sale to help fund its pending acquisition of Tylenol maker Kenvue Inc.
